# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-core-low-stepcounter

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

Standardized `coop --git` baseline on the harder 10-pair `core` subset (which includes three pairs where both features modify the same function: `dspy_task/8563`, `go_chi_task/27`, and `react_hook_form_task/153`) using `vertex_ai/gemini-3-flash-preview` (`low` thinking, 100 steps, compaction at 28K, per-turn step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap). Serves as the `core` control arm for all `gemini-3-flash-preview` communication ablations.

## Observations

- 4/10 passed overall (`$3.70`, 13 min wall time, 0 API retries), with only 3/10 clean-merge passes (`dottxt_ai_outlines_task/1655`, `llama_index_task/17244`, `openai_tiktoken_task/0`); the fourth pass (`typst_task/6554`) suffered a merge conflict and passed only via single-branch fallback.
- 6 of 10 pairs ended in merge conflicts (`go_chi_task/27`, `pallets_click_task/2800`, `pallets_jinja_task/1559`, `pallets_jinja_task/1621`, `react_hook_form_task/153`, `typst_task/6554`), confirming that `core` exposes severe edit-collision and mid-edit interruption failures on `gemini-3-flash-preview`.
- Agents sent 123 messages total (12.3 per pair) across 1,049 steps and 25 context compactions, with 1 of 20 agents reaching the 100-step limit.
